defmodule SDKFixturePlug do
  @behaviour Plug

  def init(opts), do: opts

  def call(conn, _opts) do
    current = OpenTelemetry.Tracer.current_span_ctx()

    :otel_span.set_attributes(current, %{
      "typed.int" => 9_007_199_254_740_993,
      "typed.zero" => -0.0,
      "typed.floats" => [1.5, -0.0],
      "typed.bool" => true,
      "typed.bools" => [true, false]
    })

    :otel_span.add_event(current, "cache lookup", %{"cache.hit" => false, "event.extra" => "dropped"})
    :otel_span.set_status(current, :opentelemetry.status(:ok))
    # Execute the actual Ecto instrumentation handler with synthetic Ecto metadata.
    # This does not connect to Postgres or exercise Ecto query execution.
    :telemetry.execute(
      [:fixture, :repo, :query],
      %{total_time: 10_000, query_time: 8_000, decode_time: 1_000, queue_time: 1_000, idle_time: 500},
      %{
        repo: SDKFixtureRepo,
        source: "packages",
        query: "SELECT version FROM packages WHERE name = $1",
        result: {:ok, %{}},
        type: :ecto_sql_query
      }
    )

    link =
      :opentelemetry.link(
        0x2122232425262728292A2B2C2D2E2F30,
        0x3132333435363738,
        %{"link.kind" => "async", "link.extra" => "dropped"},
        :otel_tracestate.new([{"vendor", "link"}])
      )

    task =
      OpentelemetryProcessPropagator.Task.async(fn ->
        tracer = :otel_tracer_provider.get_tracer(:global, :elixir_fixture, "1.0", "https://example.test/scope/1.0")

        :otel_tracer.with_span(
          tracer,
          "async job",
          %{
            kind: :consumer,
            links: [link],
            attributes: %{"messaging.system" => "fixture", "job.id" => 9_007_199_254_740_993}
          },
          fn _ -> :ok end
        )
      end)

    :ok = Task.await(task)
    Plug.Conn.send_resp(conn, 200, "ok")
  end
end
